comment: Generated by scripts/emc.py from mods/<port>/emc/policy.json. Explicit values for uncraftable gridwright items and conversions for machine steps ProjectE cannot see; the FAKE|no_emc conversion never resolves, so excluded items get no EMC. Everything else is derived from recipes by ProjectE.

gridwright_resonate_grid_crystal.comment: The resonator turns one redstone dust into one grid crystal using Grid Power, which has no EMC (a custom recipe type the EMC mods cannot map).
